lines.trans: Hello Noémie, am I not disturbing you?
No Mathias, everything is going very well.
Isabelle's shoot is finished.
We made it through this crazy night!
That is wonderful news for you!
It is largely thanks to your help.
You were quite simply wonderful.
I am very happy for you.
Are you not with Alexandre?
No, I am all alone.
And you, with your wife?
No, I am downstairs.
I am bringing warm croissants!
Ring quickly, I am buzzing you in!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: J'ai apporté cinq exemplaires des contrats.
examples.trans: I've brought five copies of the contracts.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: ça te dérange? = does it bother you?

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
-ir verb conjugated like an -er verb in the present

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: réussir à faire qc = to succeed in doing sth
